interpretation_limits: Archive month, report date and trade date are separate. Daily histograms are observed stored dates, not proof of complete exchange sessions.
TR_TYPE(*), settlement, delay, instrument, report-type and amendment codes remain opaque. No buy/sell, revision precedence, stable longitudinal identifier or direction semantics inferred.
VALUE (in Rs) gives a rupee unit. RATE and QUANTITY do not supply a full instrument-specific pricing convention. RATE sums and QUANTITY sums are audit controls, not economic net flows.
RATE*QUANTITY residuals are diagnostics only. Finite source-rate precision, instrument conventions, or reporting differences may matter; no values were repaired.
Candidate-key repetition and ISIN syntax/checksum diagnostics do not establish authoritative identities, duplicates to delete, or corporate-action equivalence.

All serialized content read is distinct from source authenticity, native feature behavior, historical continuity, consumer equivalence, current provider readiness, Mongo coverage, or trading suitability.
Raw source identifiers remain in the original workbook only. Evidence retains counts and bounded sheet/cell/row locators.

internal_validation.limits: Internal consistency controls are not an independent raw-data reader. Root independent lxml replay is reported separately when available.

independent_reconciliation.limits: All shared root fields for these four archives compared. A histogram or package-pin dictionary is one grouped assertion, not one assertion per element. Both readers use VALUE minus RATE times QUANTITY, so no sign inversion was required. Primary duplicate keys preserve exact decoded values; root trims values. Zero within-file whole-record and custodian-plus-transaction repeats agree under both definitions; no cross-file uniqueness is claimed. Invalid-date totals and ISIN distinct counts compare directly because no missing/invalid dates or ISIN null rows were found.

findings.finding: Four OOXML workbooks, each with one visible sheet and 16 package parts (15 XML/relationship parts and one printer-settings binary). May and June business headers occupy A:S; July and August occupy B:T with an unlabelled A-column ordinal. All 232733 July/August ordinal values match the Excel row minus one. No formulas, error cells, hidden or collapsed rows, outlined rows, hidden columns or merged ranges were found.

Date fields are numeric integer serials under the Excel1900 epoch, style index 1 using built-in number-format ID 14. All trade dates fall within the archive-labelled month. Observed report-minus-trade delays range from 0 through 7 calendar days; report dates extend into the following month, through 2019-09-05 for August. Saturday observations occur in June and August; daily histograms are stored dates, not a verified session calendar or publication timestamp.

Custodian and transaction fields mix numeric and text cells. All 19 business fields are present and nonblank. May contains 53 ISIN syntax-invalid rows; the other months have no syntax-invalid rows. No valid-format ISIN fails checksum. Spelling multiplicity and checksums do not establish security/company identity, current NSE membership or corporate-action continuity.

No exact typed nineteen-field business-record duplicates or repeats of any tested candidate key were found within each individual workbook. The candidate keys include transaction-only and custodian-plus-transaction. No cross-workbook uniqueness, stable masked-party identity or revision precedence is established.

RATE, QUANTITY and VALUE are finite nonnegative stored numbers. RATE and VALUE each contain 9623 zeroes; QUANTITY contains 294 fractional values and no zeroes. All absolute VALUE minus RATE times QUANTITY residuals are below INR 0.01; the maximum is 0.0050001930570. Exact Decimal controls retain serialized precision; sums and unsigned quantities are not net flows or ownership balances.

All rows carry DL_RPT_TYPE_N. July and August each contain one DL_AMDMNT_DEL_15 and one transaction code 23. Exchange code 99 and instrument codes REG_DL_INSTR_ID, REG_DL_INSTR_ME and REG_DL_INSTR_NC are preserved as observed. No buy/sell sign, trade direction, cancellation or replacement policy is inferred.

These historical transaction reports do not supply current five-completed-session market-wide FII/DII cash activity, quarterly ownership percentages, OHLCV bars, EPS/P/E or valuation targets. Historical research use would need versioned identity/instrument/exchange, units, revision and availability contracts plus a canonical-copy decision. No importer, runtime integration or production action is part of this evidence.
